title: Reduction and transition compatibility of signed evaluation
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a separated finite-type scheme X over D.k [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Take normalized source and finite tensor presentations with natural signed swaps and first-variable natural evaluations. Let omega be any integral constructible object with specified isomorphisms to the prescribed finite dualizing terms, and assume the evaluation-defined Hom comparisons are invertible on all ambient inputs. Then (1) the conjugated finite transition commutes with adjointed finite evaluation and the specified dualizing transition; (2) reduction of the actual delta, followed by comparison at the dual and Hom of the inverse comparison at the original input, equals the finite delta. Both identities hold for all ambient K, with no constructibility or boundedness condition on K.

source.place: Both paragraphs: evaluation-preserving reduction and the actual double-dual map.

proof.text: On K-flat sources and a K-injective target, use the two-term free quotient model and the coefficient unit to check the evaluation square for quotient transitions. Adjunction and cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms give the first equation.

Uncurry the reduced delta. Evaluation and arbitrary-transpose compatibility, together with preservation of the Koszul swap by the normalized scalar tensorator, identify its inverse transpose with the finite signed evaluation. Injectivity of the finite adjunction gives the second equation. The original-input comparison is inverted because Hom is contravariant.

theorem reductionPairing
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl))
    (s : SignedSymmetry X (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl) a)
    (hs : ∀ (K L K' L' : Ambient l E X) (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'),
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (s.swap K' L').hom =
        (s.swap K L).hom ≫ a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (m : ∀ n : ℕ, IntegralHom.ReductionPresentation l E X D hl a n)
    (t : ∀ n : ℕ, SignedSymmetry X (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      (m n).target)
    (ht : ∀ (n : ℕ) (K L K' L' : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionTarget l E X n))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'),
      (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ ((t n).swap K' L').hom =
        ((t n).swap K L).hom ≫ (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (he : ∀ (K K' W : Ambient l E X) (f : K' ⟶ K),
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
        ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl)).map
          (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 W)))) ≫ (a.adjunction K').counit.app W =
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫ (a.adjunction K).counit.app W)
    (het : ∀ (n : ℕ) (K K' W : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionTarget l E X n))
      (f : K' ⟶ K),
      (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
        ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)).map
          (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 W)))) ≫ ((m n).target.adjunction K').counit.app W =
      (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫
        ((m n).target.adjunction K).counit.app W)
    (ω : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (r : ∀ n : ℕ, (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj ω.obj ≅
      integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n)
    (h : ∀ (K : Ambient l E X) (n : ℕ), IsIso (comparison l E X D hl (m n) ω r K)) :
    (∀ (K : Ambient l E X) (n : ℕ),
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K) (finiteTransition l E X D hl m ω r K (h K) n)) ≫
        finiteEvaluation l E X D hl m K n =
      finiteEvaluation l E X D hl m K (n + 1) ≫ dualizingTransition l E X D ω r n) ∧
    (∀ (K : Ambient l E X) (n : ℕ),
      (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).map (delta X a s ω.obj K) ≫
        comparison l E X D hl (m n) ω r ((dual l E X ω.obj).obj (op K)) ≫
        (IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)).map
          (Prod.mkHom (@asIso _ _ _ _ (comparison l E X D hl (m n) ω r K)
            (h K n)).inv.op (𝟙 (integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n))) =
      delta X (m n).target (t n) (integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n)
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K))
